description: Ministry of Labour - Collective Agreement between Habib Bank Ltd. Vs. Ceylon Bank Employees Union (E only)
reasoning: This gazette content publishes a Collective Agreement between Habib Bank Ltd. and the Ceylon Bank Employees Union under Section 06 of the Industrial Disputes Act. It contains detailed regulatory terms and conditions of employment, salary revisions, and contractual obligations, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change.
